forecast_cutoff: 00:00 Europe/London on fixture date; all same-date forecasts precede all same-date Elo updates
result_availability: next Europe/London calendar day 00:00; historical publication latency and revisions are not archived
parameter_refit: first forecast day of each calendar two-month bucket: Jan-Feb, Mar-Apr, May-Jun, Jul-Aug, Sep-Oct, Nov-Dec
prequential_test: Hyperparameters and validation winner frozen before test; earlier test outcomes may update future predictions under the identical predetermined schedule

performance_mechanisms.change: fixed arithmetic 50/50 mixture of dc_365 and causal Elo multinomial probabilities

dixon_coles: Use corrected production constrained joint likelihood, unchanged constants and constraints; equal/365/180 fit identical prior-match IDs

elo.inactive_team_policy: retain last rating; unseen teams start neutral; no lower-league information
elo.probability_mapping: multinomial LogisticRegression C=1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-8; same rolling fit IDs as Dixon-Coles; no posthoc calibration

descriptive_benchmarks.league_frequency: Dirichlet(1,1,1) smoothed outcomes on identical rolling fit population
descriptive_benchmarks.elo_component: Reported to expose component behavior, excluded from validation selection
descriptive_benchmarks.closing_market: Normalize reciprocals of AvgCH, AvgCD, AvgCA. Later-information benchmark only, excluded from model inputs and selection. Report available subset and all models on exactly that subset; no odds imputation

selection_rule: minimum pooled validation per-match natural-log loss among the four selectable models; fixed tie order; serialize selection lock before loading test labels
secondary_metrics: class probability means minus class frequencies

blocks: nonoverlapping 28-calendar-day blocks anchored to each season's first fixture date
uncertainty.stratification: resample blocks independently within each season; preserve season match-count weights
uncertainty.interpretation: conditional uncertainty within these two historical seasons; not independent-season generalization, prospective evidence, or multiple-comparison-adjusted discovery

failure_policy: Fail on incomplete season, invalid score/result, duplicate fixture, nonfinite probability or failed optimizer. Preserve diagnostics; do not silently omit matches or replace models.
limitations: neutral treatment of previously unseen promoted clubs
